info.name: Apple Photos Connector
info.summary: Import originals and albums from Apple Photos with the Nextcloud APC macOS app
info.description:
Connect Apple Photos to Nextcloud using the separate Nextcloud APC macOS app, which is required and is not included in this server app.
The macOS app reads your selected photos and videos from Apple Photos and imports their original files into Nextcloud. Repeated imports transfer new or missing files; files already present and confirmed by the connector are not uploaded again. Albums can be imported into Nextcloud Photos.
Imports are intentionally non-destructive: existing files are not overwritten, and photos missing from Apple Photos do not cause automatic deletion of files or album memberships in Nextcloud.
info.author: Frank Kettenbeil
